title: Overview
description: A high-level introduction to FastAPI, its key features, performance benefits, and what makes it a modern choice for building APIs.

title: Getting Started
description: A step-by-step tutorial to guide you from installation to creating and running your first FastAPI application.

title: User Guide
description: Explore the core concepts of FastAPI with practical, step-by-step examples covering everything from parameters to dependency injection.

title: Path Parameters
description: Learn how to declare and validate path parameters in your API endpoints, including type hints and numeric validations.

title: Query Parameters
description: Understand how to define, validate, and document query parameters, including string validations, default values, and aliases.

title: Request Body
description: Learn how to receive and validate data from the request body using Pydantic models, including nested data structures and multiple body parameters.

title: Handling Responses
description: Control the API response by defining response models, changing status codes, and setting custom headers and cookies.

title: Dependency Injection
description: Master FastAPI's powerful dependency injection system to manage dependencies, share logic, and handle authentication and database connections.

title: Advanced Topics
description: Dive deeper into advanced features like security, middleware, WebSockets, and structuring larger applications for production environments.

title: Security
description: Implement authentication and authorization in your API using various security schemes like OAuth2, HTTP Basic Auth, and API Keys.

title: Middleware
description: Learn how to use and create middleware to process requests and responses, handle CORS, GZip, and implement custom logic.

title: WebSockets
description: Enable real-time, bidirectional communication between clients and your server using WebSockets.

title: Bigger Applications
description: Discover strategies for structuring large, production-ready applications by splitting your API into multiple files and routers.

title: Testing
description: Write effective tests for your FastAPI application, including unit and integration tests for dependencies, and event handlers.

title: API Reference
description: Detailed technical documentation of FastAPI's public API, including classes, functions, and utilities for developers.

title: FastAPI Application
description: Comprehensive reference for the main `FastAPI` application class, its configuration options, and methods.

title: Routing
description: In-depth guide to `APIRouter` and `APIRoute` for structuring path operations and creating modular applications.

title: Parameters
description: Detailed documentation for parameter-defining functions like `Path`, `Query`, `Header`, `Cookie`, `Body`, and `Form`.

title: Dependencies
description: Reference for the dependency injection system, including `Depends` and `Security`.

title: Responses
description: A complete reference for all available response classes, including `JSONResponse`, `HTMLResponse`, and `StreamingResponse`.

title: Security Utilities
description: Reference for all security-related utilities, including OAuth2, HTTP Basic/Bearer/Digest, and API Keys.

title: Contributing
description: Learn how you can contribute to the FastAPI project, report security issues, and understand the project's internal scripts and maintenance.
